verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists a built-in 'Conversational meeting assistant' (fathom-docs-29), alongside AI-driven automations such as automatic CRM field updates after meetings (fathom-docs-12) and custom AI summaries (fathom-docs-47). These suggest some in-product assistant capability, but there is no documentation of what tasks can be delegated to it or how it works. The MCP server only connects Fathom data to external assistants, so it does not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of the in-product assistant's capabilities and scope of delegable tasks, evidence it can take actions beyond answering questions, hands-on or independent corroboration.
